creativeadmin.help.title: How Creative Admin works
creativeadmin.help.overview.heading: How it works
creativeadmin.help.overview.body: Creative Admin decides what creative mode hands out, player by player. The server checks every item a restricted player takes from the creative menu, the search tab, saved hotbars, pick-block or an item browser mod, whatever their client runs: players do not need this mod. Rules are grouped in profiles, and each player gets at most one. Items a player already owns are never touched.
creativeadmin.help.profiles.heading: Profiles and modes
creativeadmin.help.profiles.body: Type a name under the profile list and press + to create a profile: 1 to 32 characters, lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Duplicate copies the selected profile, Delete removes it. Each profile has a mode. Whitelist: everything is locked except what you open. Blacklist: everything is open except what you lock. Switching the mode keeps the selection and flips its meaning.
creativeadmin.help.items.heading: Tabs and items
creativeadmin.help.items.body: Opens the profile's page. Pick a tab on the left, click its lock to open or lock the whole page, or click single items in the grid: a click changes that item only, whatever its tab, mod or tags say. The search box looks through every item. The grid shows the final result of every rule of the profile, so what it shows locked is what players find locked.
creativeadmin.help.advanced.heading: Mods, tags, components
creativeadmin.help.advanced.body: Optional rules, for broader choices. A mod selects every item of its namespace, a tag (#namespace:tag) every item it holds. An item may only carry the data components ordinary play produces or the creative menu offers; add a component here to allow it. Two switches, off by default, let items carry a block's stored data and let shulker boxes and bundles carry items, whose contents follow the same profile.
creativeadmin.help.server.heading: Server settings
creativeadmin.help.server.body: Restrictions active turns everything on or off: when off, creative mode behaves like vanilla for everyone. The default profile applies to players with no assignment and no profile from their group; without one they are not restricted. Unrestricted from op sets the op level from which players are never restricted, used when no permission mod answers creativeadmin.bypass.
creativeadmin.help.players.heading: Players
creativeadmin.help.players.body: The Players page lists online and assigned players, the profile that applies to each and where it comes from. Click a player to cycle their profile; an assignment is saved at once, without Save, and a new profile must be saved before it can be assigned. For each player the first match wins: the bypass, a profile assigned here, a profile from their group, the default profile.
creativeadmin.help.groups.heading: Groups and permissions
creativeadmin.help.groups.body: Give a LuckPerms group or a CustomPerm grade the meta creativeadmin.profile = <profile>, for example /lp group builders meta set creativeadmin.profile event or /customperm grade meta builders set creativeadmin.profile event. The permission creativeadmin.bypass is never restricted. creativeadmin.admin opens this screen and runs the commands; without a permission mod it takes op level 3.
creativeadmin.help.saving.heading: Save and undo
creativeadmin.help.saving.body: Edits stay on your screen until you press Save; Undo changes throws them away, and closing with unsaved edits asks first. If another admin saved in the meantime, your save is refused rather than overwriting theirs: undo to load their version, then make your change again. Players get the new rules as soon as a save succeeds.
creativeadmin.help.files.heading: Files and errors
creativeadmin.help.files.body: The rules live in config/creative-admin/policy.json and the assignments in assignments.json next to it. Both can be edited by hand and applied with /creativeadmin reload. The mod fails closed: an unreadable or malformed file refuses creative items to every restricted player until it is fixed and reloaded, and this screen is read-only meanwhile so it cannot overwrite the file to repair.
creativeadmin.help.commands.heading: Commands
creativeadmin.help.commands.body: /creativeadmin status shows whether restrictions are on, the profiles, the default and the bypass level. reload re-reads both files and reports rule entries that match nothing. tabs lists the tab ids a rule can name. check [profile] evaluates the item in your hand and prints the rule that refused it. profile <players> <profile> assigns, profile <players> clear removes the assignment. All work from the console and from a vanilla client.
creativeadmin.help.companion.heading: With Better Creative
creativeadmin.help.companion.body: Players who also run Better Creative no longer see locked tabs in its settings screen, so they cannot switch them back on, and the tab bar is both filtered and sorted. Each mod works without the other.
creativeadmin.help.limits.heading: What is not covered
creativeadmin.help.limits.body: Items already in the world or already owned, on purpose. Command, structure and jigsaw blocks, which vanilla gates at op level 2. /give, gated by vanilla at op level 2. Lag built from open blocks: a profile of harmless items still allows a redstone clock.
